title: Rockstar Games Employees Set Union Vote for GTA6 Release Window
description: Rockstar Games employees have locked in a union vote date taking place over the GTA6 release window, aiming to form the UK's largest recognized union.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Union Vote Scheduled for Rockstar Games Employees

A significant milestone has been reached for the workforce behind one of the most anticipated titles in gaming history. According to reports from Eurogamer, a date has officially been locked in for Rockstar Games employees to vote on whether to recognise their developer union.

## Timing Around the GTA6 Release Window

What makes this development particularly noteworthy is the timeline. The voting process is set to take place over the release window of Grand Theft Auto 6. As anticipation builds for the massive title, this internal process places a unique spotlight on the working conditions and organizational efforts within the studio.

If the vote is successful, the milestone will carry substantial weight across the broader industry. It is projected to become the largest recognised union across the entirety of the UK video games industry, potentially setting a precedent for collective representation in major gaming studios.

## Editor's Take

Conducting a union vote during the high-pressure release window of GTA6 places unique focus on the studio's workforce. Regardless of the outcome, this move highlights the evolving landscape of labor organization within major gaming companies and sets the stage for broader industry discussions.
